svg.title: Deploy with Terraform
svg.desc: Deployment ownership diagram. Before deployment, protected Blob state, approved private deployment access, one state key per root, and Entra authentication are supplied separately and are not created by these roots. The focal Platform root at terraform/ owns the Foundry account, project, model deployment, private network, identities, backing services, private monitoring, and optional API Management and admin VM. The platform passes reviewed IDs and names to roots that read platform resources: the Lab root at workbench/infra/ owns private Container Apps, registry, runtime identity, the application database, operational monitoring, and an optional email action group with no recipients by default; the optional Bastion root at terraform/bastion/ provides admin access and is billed while it exists; the optional agent monitoring root at terraform/monitoring/ provides metadata-only agent tracing. Release workflows, not Terraform hooks, build images and pin the Lab digest, publish agent versions and verify or recover routes, and run smoke checks and approved quality evaluations. A successful deployment does not prove answer quality, and each root keeps its own state.
svg.text: Terraform roots own infrastructure; release workflows publish code and agents separately.
